title: Bind native acceptance to the selected compiler and executed workspace tests
goal: Require positive test evidence and prevent host Cargo compiler, documentation-tool and wrapper settings from substituting tools in integration, release or the private standard-library build.
regressions: Three focused local-release workspace_test_count tests require positive Rust harness evidence.
Real Cargo runs with hostile host rustc, rustdoc, rustc-wrapper, rustc-workspace-wrapper and rustflags must avoid the tripwire; the unbound control must execute it.
